Encore 0.4.0: downloads. Keep songs, playlists, albums and your liked songs
on your computer, and listen without a connection.

## Download

| System | File |
|---|---|
| macOS (Apple silicon and Intel) | `Encore_0.4.0_universal.dmg` |
| Windows 10 and 11 | `Encore_0.4.0_x64-setup.exe` (or the `.msi`) |
| Debian 12+, Ubuntu 22.04+ | `Encore_0.4.0_amd64.deb` |
| Other Linux (glibc 2.35+) | `Encore_0.4.0_amd64.AppImage` |

## First launch

These builds are not code-signed yet.

- **macOS:** open the app once, then go to **System Settings → Privacy &
  Security** and choose **Open Anyway**. macOS asks once for access to your
  saved session in the Keychain.
- **Windows:** SmartScreen warns on first run. Choose **More info**, then
  **Run anyway**. If Smart App Control is on, Windows blocks the app.

Updating from 0.3.0 keeps your session, settings and player components.

## What's new

- **Download songs** from any track's menu, or press <kbd>D</kbd> for the
  song that's playing. Each song is the audio YouTube serves, untouched, at
  the same quality Encore plays, and is stored once on your computer.
- **Download a playlist, an album or your liked songs** with the Download
  button on its page. Encore keeps it up to date: new songs are downloaded,
  and songs are only removed after a check that read the whole list.
- **A Downloads page** in the sidebar lists your songs and collections, what
  is downloading, and anything that couldn't be downloaded and why. Rows
  everywhere show a mark once a song is downloaded.
- **Offline, Encore notices by itself.** A banner says so, downloaded songs
  play, the queue passes over the others, and lyrics and covers still show.
  Plays made offline are not sent to your YouTube history.
- Downloaded songs keep playing even if you remove the player components.
- Downloads go one at a time, a few seconds apart, and wait while a song you
  chose is loading. If YouTube asks for a bot check, they pause for 10
  minutes, then 30, then until you choose **Try again**.
- Signing out or switching channels never deletes downloads. Collections
  downloaded under another account say which one keeps them up to date.
- **Settings → Storage** shows how much space downloads use, and can remove
  them all.
- Search and the command box offer the download actions, and search your
  downloaded songs while offline.
- `encore-cli downloads` lists, adds, keeps and removes downloads from the
  command line.

## Fixes

- When YouTube asks for a bot check, Encore no longer asks again straight
  away, which made the check more likely to stick.
- A song whose stream link is refused even after a fresh link is skipped
  with a reason, instead of stopping playback.

Encore is unofficial and not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
